prying_times: Quest start at Squawking Steve Beanie in The Pandemonium; 12 Sailing and 30 Smithing are not boostable.
The route transfers a crate of looty into the ship cargo hold at Port Sarim and back to the ledger at The Pandemonium before the special key discussion.
Thurgo near Mudskipper Point exchanges one steel bar, redberry pie and a retained hammer for a reusable crowbar. Steve then requests an offshore crate test.
The fish bladder stout spawns a drink troll; returning to safe buoys is a valid combat-free option to end the encounter.
On completion: 1 quest point, 1,000 Smithing XP, 800 Sailing XP, 25 sawmill coupons for oak planks, access to crowbars and forgotten-drink charts.
crab_quest: Quest begins by drinking from a mysterious bottle on Dognose Island; 40 Sailing and 30 Fishing are required.
Nine scattered shells are offered to the crab before the player nets three pieces of flotsam and builds a string instrument.
At least six crab leaders are needed to proceed; more can be recruited but should not block optimal quest completion. Shy crabs can require the Sit emote and a wait.
A sand-nest demonstration and the mating ceremony lead to completion and awakening at the bottle.
On completion: 1 quest point, 10,000 Sailing XP, 3,000 Fishing XP and a shell collection with seven playable notes, recoverable from the original bottle.

cross_branch_dependencies: Sailing boat construction, ship ownership, captain's log and the Port Task system depend on quest.pandemonium and Sailing progression, both uncollected on this branch.
The Port Sarim–Pandemonium and Pandemonium–Dognose ship travel estimates should be reconciled with a shared Sailing route graph when Pandemonium and sea travel are integrated.
review_gaps: Only seven individual Crab Quest shell tiles were identified from pinned helper waypoints. Two shell pickup locations remain approximate, though exactly nine shells are required.
The current Crab Quest replay recruits six of the many possible crabs. Optional seven-through-twelve recruit variations and longer shy-crab pauses are not yet represented.
The Sailing completion rewards are fixed XP, but incidental Fishing XP from flotsam and incidental sailing XP from boat steering/trim are not modeled.
Ship hold physical mechanics are abstracted by an inventory cargo token. Verify boarding, docking, port task-slot availability and whether the captain's log is retained after quest start.
Prying Times' cargo ledger Port Sarim coordinate and sea-crate access, plus two Crab Quest shell tiles, need live waypoint verification. Sailing timing and cost estimates remain provisional.
The Prying Times troll encounter follows the non-combat buoy escape route; the alternative troll fight, its supplies and XP are not estimated.
Repeated crowbar acquisition and lost shell-collection reclaims are documented as unlocked, but no independently repeatable inventory-producing claims are modeled.

The Prying Times quest requirements may imply access gained from Pandemonium; pinned helper lists no quest completion requirement, so only its 12 Sailing/30 Smithing gates are enforced until a live requirements check.
Upstream tradeable steel bar, redberry pie and hammer supplies, along with initial captain's log and boat, must be present in focused replay until Sailing integration provides producers.
notes: Two isolated Sailing quests in one worker batch; full route replay is seeded with a ship and required prior supplies, with no claim over the unfinished Pandemonium quest.
